Name: Aah Impossible Rescue
Overview: Aah Impossible Rescue tasks the player with guiding three kittens who are stranded in a river across twelve levels to safety, whilst controlling all three at the same time. As the three kittens go downstream, the player must use the A, X and Y keys, which correspond to one of the kittens, to move them up and down in their respective streams. If any of the three kittens hit an obstacle however, all three of them are returned to the last checkpoint.
